grid.note: First-world Eris workspace origin from the $7A92/$7A2C world-local camera pairs; 65,536 raw units per cell (docs/research/damocles-catalogue.md).

start.evidence: research/damocles-st/snapshots/eris-spaceport-onfoot.sav: $7A92 = $004770B1, $7A96 = 63, $7A9A = $00886C2D, on foot ($7A8E = 1), cell $87; camera yaw word $7AA2 = $0600, the panel compass centred on N (docs/research/damocles-walk-board-flight.md, yaw-probe runs 2026-09-11).

walk.evidence: Speed rate: 3 cells over 30,000 VBL at 50 Hz (observe-walk-toward-building, docs/research/damocles-walk-board-flight.md), retained as a derived average because movement runs on the render/game loop rather than every VBL. Turn rate: the opening wall-clock rate is about 0.49 rad/s, retained as a derived average because the recovered increment varies with heading. Exact-VBL #205 traces recover the quantized updates: forward $30 plain and $50 under the latched R mode (5/3 times); initial north-facing right turn $10 plain and $18 under R (3/2 times), with later heading-dependent turn increments. Probe and provenance: research/damocles-st/scripts/walk-step-probe.py and docs/research/damocles-walk-board-flight.md.

orientation.note: Camera yaw $7AA2 (twin $7AC2) wraps every 1024 units; N is centred at $0200 mod $0400, E at $0300, S at $0000, W at $0100, and a right stick raises it. Walking at N raises $7A9A (z) and at E raises $7A92 (x), so Eris is left-handed seen from above with +y up; the frame mirrors z for the shared right-handed Camera. Instance heading bytes at $79CD+slot are 256 steps per turn on the same clockwise sense with zero at north (camera ≡ byte×4+$200 mod $400). Whether a model's z runs with world z is not decoded; modelZ is authored to match the Working Authority's spaceport view (docs/research/damocles-walk-board-flight.md).

palette.note: Live hardware palette at $06FD00 while outdoors on foot (docs/research/damocles-filled-polygons.md).

ground.note: Authored fill in the recovered green over the whole first-world workspace, drawn as rings around the eye and clipped to the workspace, standing in for the ground the catalogue does not decode: the $7000 road templates and $F0/$F4 neighbour joins that would fill the rest of a cell around its recovered faces (#221). fillDropUnits is how far below y = 0 it sits so those recovered faces draw over it without z-fighting. Eris is an island, so the fill also stands in for the sea: where land gives way to water is not yet recovered, and the same green runs to the workspace edge until it is. Recovered pad and road polygons come from the Damocles Catalogue ground family (docs/research/damocles-eris-ground.md).

sky.note: Palette entry 246 read as the daytime sky; no sky model is decoded.

lighting.note: Authored Enhanced-preset sun, hemisphere ambient and shadow pass (#209, #231). Authentic faces remain flat in their catalogue colours.

structureFallback.evidence: Fallback only: when a structure has no complete recovered selector or no region matches, draw its combined closed inspection assembly without baked resident objects.
